gloss: to value, to respect, to esteem

definitions.gloss: to value, to prize, to treasure
definitions.explanation: To regard something as important or precious.

definitions.gloss: to respect, to esteem, to revere
definitions.explanation: To hold someone or something in high regard.

examples.japanese: {自由|じゆう}を{尊|たっと}ぶ{精神|せいしん}。
{私|わたし}たちは{平和|へいわ}を{何|なに}より{尊|たっと}ばなければならない。
examples.english: We must value peace above all else.

examples.japanese: {先輩|せんぱい}を{尊|たっと}ぶ。
{師|し}を{尊|たっと}ぶ{心|こころ}を{持|も}つ。
examples.english: To have a heart that respects one's teacher.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{学問|がくもん}を{尊|たっと}び、{生涯|しょうがい}{学|まな}び{続|つづ}けた。
examples.english: He valued learning and continued to study throughout his life.

notes:
{尊|たっと}ぶ expresses valuing or respecting something highly.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)

VARIANT:
Also read as {尊|とうと}ぶ (same meaning). Both readings are correct.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {命|いのち}を{尊|たっと}ぶ: to value life
- {伝統|でんとう}を{尊|たっと}ぶ: to respect tradition
- {人権|じんけん}を{尊|たっと}ぶ: to value human rights

RELATED:
- {尊|とうと}い/{尊|たっと}い: precious, noble (adjective)
- {尊敬|そんけい}する: to respect (more common in everyday speech)
- {崇|あが}める: to worship, to idolize
